mapper.select: SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(1) > 0 THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END FROM user_block ub WHERE ub.user_id = #{userId} AND ub.blocked_user_id = #{blockedUserId} AND ub.status = 0 AND ub.deleted_at IS NULL LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_block ( id, user_id, blocked_user_id, status, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{userId}, #{blockedUserId}, 0, NOW(), NOW(), NULL ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE status = 0, deleted_at = NULL, updated_at = NOW()
mapper.update: UPDATE user_block SET status = 1, deleted_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND blocked_user_id = #{blockedUserId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
